description:
Create a 'Quad-View' radiological summary of the loaded CT Cranium dataset. 

1. Generate a 3D surface of the skull (using the standard Bone threshold).
2. Change the background color of the 3D visualization panel to WHITE (to save ink for printing).
3. Navigate the Axial, Sagittal, and Coronal slice views so they all display the center of the cranium (showing clear anatomical structures like orbits, sinuses, or braincase), not the empty start/end slices.
4. Ensure the layout is set to the standard 4-panel view (Axial, Sagittal, Coronal, and 3D).
5. Export a screenshot of the full interface (showing all 4 panels) to '/home/ga/Documents/radiology_summary.png'.
